name: Threshold theorem
statement: δ_{R,K,N} ≤ L_{R,K}+T_{R,K}σ_{K,N}; if δ<1 and complement lower frame holds, restricted source floor survives.

name: Optimization criterion
statement: Choose (R,K,y) maximizing β_R(1-δ_{R,K,N}^2) subject to length, source, and tail records.

name: Low-leakage warning
statement: K<R no longer gives exact annihilation in the central-line metric; it gives weighted leakage L_{R,K}.

name: Tail warning
statement: Increasing K reduces seed tail σ_K but increases low-Ω leakage L_{R,K}.

name: Nonclaim
statement: Finite threshold optimization is not RH evidence without actual Burnol/Müntz seed tail and completed ledger promotion.
